text:
deploybot: Roll attempt blocked for release route-service v2026.04.01 — preflight flagged chart-default drift: autoscaler.policy changed between environments.

deploybot: Preflight details: https://internal.redwood/preflight/1789999999

alex: pasting staging/prod values we saw quickly

alex: staging values.yaml excerpt:
```
autoscaler:
  enabled: true
  policy: bursty
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 5
```

alex: prod values.yaml excerpt:
```
autoscaler:
  enabled: true
  policy: steady
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 5
```

maya: chart refactor merged last week bumped default policy -> bursty in chart 4.0.0; staging auto-upgraded in CI. Prod pinned to 3.9.2 so defaults diverged.

sam: quick options before prod change window (in ~40m): pin chart in release, add prod-only valuesOverride, or promote chart now (needs smoke canary + cost sign-off).

jen: we should not change autoscaling semantics in prod mid-window without approval. Best course: prod-only override + pin chart. Keep rollout paused until infra reconciles.

alex: I can prepare a minimal valuesOverride for prod: `autoscaler.policy: steady` and `minReplicas: 2` then re-run preflight. No image change.

maya: agree. also create a Jira to track unifying chart defaults and make preflight rule to catch `autoscaler.policy` drift moving forward.

alex: created ticket RDW-5012: "chart defaults: align autoscaler.policy across release channels" assigned to eng-infra: https://jira.redwood/RDW-5012

ops-bot: preflight recheck scheduled in 45s

eng-infra-bot: quick note — will add a linter to CI to flag explicit default changes, but that will take a day.

ops-bot: preflight recheck completed. Diff shows prod-only valuesOverride added: `autoscaler.policy: steady`, `minReplicas: 2`. Release remains PAUSED awaiting manual approval from @sam.

deploybot: Preflight diff summary: no image changes; manifest only altered for prod values overlay.

sam: hold this release for this window. Alex, pin the image tag in the registry and mark release as "staged-only". Add a short note in the changelog explaining the hold and link RDW-5012.

alex: done — manifest pinned to route-service:v2026.03.29-91, changelog updated with note: "autoscaler defaults held in prod due to chart refactor; follow-up in RDW-5012"

maya: I'll watch cluster scaling metrics for 6 hours post-change and add alerts to #ops-scaling. If anything anomalous, I'll @pagerduty.

jen: also add a runbook blurb in the release notes: when config parity causes hold, how to escalate and where overrides live.

sam: thanks all. Leaving thread open for infra remediation updates only. No deploy commands until RDW-5012 completed.

deploybot: Release status: PAUSED_BY_POLICY. Thread locked for deploy commands.
